headlines.title: 5 Blue-Chip Dividend Stocks Built to Keep Paying Through Tough Markets
headlines.summary: A fat yield means nothing if the cash isn't there to fund it. Five blue chips face the same coverage test, and two of them pay out with almost no room to spare. Which dividends hold up when markets turn?

headlines.title: PepsiCo (PEP) Stock May Be 49% Undervalued Following Margin Concerns
headlines.summary: PepsiCo has seen a muted share price journey in recent years, and investors are increasingly asking whether the current valuation is still supported by the cash the business can generate. With the stock around US$140.54 at the last close, the key issue is how that price lines up against the strength and timing of its future cash flows. The share price has edged down about 7.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola vs. PepsiCo: Which Consumer Goods Stock Is a Better Buy for 2027?
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola's asset-light model and PepsiCo's snack empire take very different routes to the same shelf, and their valuation gap may decide the winner.

headlines.title: 41 ETFs Add to PepsiCo (PEP) Holdings on Nov. 19
headlines.summary: ETFs bought $40.1 million of PepsiCo stock in Thursday's session.

headlines.title: What These 6 Snack and Beverage Stocks Have in Common
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola and an array of other beverage and snack stocks deliver tasty dividends to income investors.

description: PepsiCo, Inc. engages in the manufacture, marketing, distribution, and sale of various beverages and convenient foods worldwide. The company operates through six segments: PepsiCo Foods North America; PepsiCo Beverages North America; International Beverages Franchise; Europe, Middle East and Africa; Latin America Foods; and Asia Pacific Foods. It offers cereals, chips, dips, granola bars, oatmeal, pasta, rice, and syrups and mixes; refrigerated dips and spreads; beverage concentrates, fountain syrups, and finished goods; and ready-to-drink tea and coffee products. The company also provides SodaStream sparkling water makers and related products, as well as various dairy products under the Agusha, Chudo, and Domik v Derevne brands. It serves wholesale and other distributors, foodservice customers, grocery stores, drug stores, convenience stores, discount/dollar stores, mass merchandisers, membership stores, hard discounters, e-commerce retailers and authorized independent bottlers, and others through a network of direct-store-delivery, customer warehouse, and distributor networks, as well as directly to consumers through e-commerce platforms and retailers. PepsiCo, Inc. was founded in 1898 and is based in Purchase, New York.
